children: Bitcoin spot ETFs recorded a net outflow of $463 million during the trading week from September 7 to September 11, U.S. Eastern Time. According to PANews, Ark & 21 Shares ETF ARKB saw the largest weekly outflow at $234 million, bringing its cumulative net inflow to $1.22 billion.

Grayscale's Bitcoin Trust GBTC posted a weekly outflow of $129 million, with cumulative net outflows reaching $27.78 billion. Morgan Stanley ETF MSBT recorded the largest weekly inflow at $19.645 million, and its cumulative net inflow stood at $529 million.

As of press time, Bitcoin spot ETFs held total net assets of $97.58 billion. The ETF net asset ratio, measured by market value as a share of Bitcoin's total market value, was 6.28%, and cumulative net inflows reached $55.15 billion.

title: Bitcoin Spot ETFs Record $463 Million Net Outflow Last Week
